title: Efficient Safety Guardrails through Latent Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning with On-Demand Trace Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.18304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Guardrail approaches that rely on reasoning-based large language models (LLM) improve safety decisions, but come with substantial inference overhead due to the explicit reasoning. We introduce LR-Guard (Latent Reasoning Guardrail), an efficient and explainable guardrail that jointly learns structured latent reasoning and on-demand reasoning reconstruction. Our method distills a frozen teacher's analysis of safe and unsafe prompt interpretations and their comparison into compact latent representations. Joint training optimizes these representations for both safety prediction and reconstruction of the teacher's explicit reasoning traces, enabling human-readable explanations without requiring intermediate text generation for every decision. translated_title: 基于潜在双假设推理与按需轨迹重构的高效安全护栏
translated_abstract: 依赖推理型大型语言模型（LLM）的护栏方法能够改善安全决策，但由于显式推理而带来巨大的推理开销。我们提出了LR-Guard（潜在推理护栏），这是一种高效且可解释的护栏，它联合学习结构化潜在推理和按需推理重构。我们的方法将冻结教师模型对安全和不安全提示解释的分析及其比较蒸馏为紧凑的潜在表示。联合训练同时针对安全预测和教师模型显式推理轨迹的重构来优化这些表示，从而无需为每个决策生成中间文本即可提供人类可读的解释。实验表明，LR-Guard在大多数域内和域外设置中的安全分类和解释提取任务上优于其显式推理教师模型，同时实现了19.4倍的推理加速。
tldr: LR-Guard将教师模型的显式安全推理蒸馏为紧凑的潜在表示并支持按需的推理轨迹重构，在实现19.4倍推理加速的同时，在安全分类和解释提取上超越了其显式推理教师模型。
en_tdlr: LR-Guard distills a teacher's explicit safety reasoning into compact latent representations with on-demand trace reconstruction, achieving a 19.4x inference speedup while outperforming its explicit-reasoning teacher in safety classification and explanation extraction.
